ornith-4bit.label: Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B, 4-bit (MLX)
ornith-4bit.notes: 18 GiB of weights, 128k context. Measured about 55–65 tokens/s on this Mac. Default for coding.

simple.about: Recommended. Answers questions and helps with code.

qwen36-27b-4bit.label: Qwen 3.6 27B, 4-bit (MLX)
qwen36-27b-4bit.notes: 15 GiB. Dense model, often rated the strongest for code. Slower per token than Ornith.

simple.about: Strong for code, but slower per answer.

qwen36-35b-a3b-4bit.label: Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B, 4-bit (MLX)
qwen36-35b-a3b-4bit.notes: 19 GiB. Mixture of experts: faster per token, good for chat.

simple.about: Faster per answer. Good for everyday chat.

ornith-9b-4bit.label: Ornith 1.5 9B, 4-bit (MLX)
ornith-9b-4bit.notes: 4.7 GiB. Small and fast, for quick checks and simple questions.

simple.about: Small and quick. For simple questions and checks.

chat.label: Chat: 32k context, no cache, quick start
